head.title: User starts the conversation
head.detail: Types a question or picks a prompt from the hero. Example: "My sales don't match what I filed in GST."

head.title: Identify the problem statement
head.detail: DataTwin matches the message to a guided flow by its words. When the message points clearly at one, it goes straight to that flow's understanding card.

head.title: User chooses the category (only when unclear)
head.detail: If the message doesn't point at a side of GST, DataTwin asks which one. When the message does point at a side, or at one check, this step is skipped and the conversation travels to that category on its own.

problems.name: Sales Register vs GSTR-1
problems.summary: Confirm every outward invoice is reported completely and correctly before the mismatch becomes a notice or a tax shortfall. Result is framed as a recovery: money that can come back, net of anything short-paid.

steps.title: Show what was understood
steps.detail:
Problem: Your sales register and what's reported in GSTR-1 may not agree, so some invoices could be missing, duplicated or reported with the wrong value or tax.
What you're after: Confirm every outward invoice is reported completely and correctly before the mismatch becomes a notice or a tax shortfall.
What I'll check: Invoice-level match on taxable value, tax amount and tax rate; Place of supply and B2B vs B2C classification; Credit notes, debit notes and amendments tied back to original invoices.
